wins: Maintained steady reward accumulation of 50.00 per episode despite failure to reach success threshold, indicating consistent tactical action execution.
Triggered mentor calls 10 times, providing multiple opportunities for guidance and policy refinement.
fails: Zero percent success rate suggests inability to complete critical mission objective within the single episode.
Reliance on mentor calls implies incomplete solo decision-making flow, possibly due to unfamiliar environment variables.
key_outcomes.summary: Run delivered consistent intermediate rewards but failed to complete the end goal; focus should shift to strategic objective handling and decision independence.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Episode consistently stalls before final objective completion despite accumulating intermediate rewards.

skill_cards.if_condition: When mission state shows intermediate rewards but final objective incomplete
skill_cards.then_action: Re-evaluate remaining objectives with prioritization matrix and trigger focused action plan

skill_cards.if_condition: When mentor call count increases beyond 5 within an episode
skill_cards.then_action: Activate internal decision audit to identify ambiguity in policy selection

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance yields consistent data but action plan not executed
skill_cards.then_action: Translate reconnaissance findings into explicit actionable tasks with checkpoints

memory_ops.reason: High correlation between intermediate reward accumulation and potential for objective completion with structured re-evaluation.
Mentor call surge indicates policy ambiguity; auditing decisions improves autonomy.

next_experiments.title: Objective Prioritization Reinforcement
next_experiments.description: Implement a decision layer that re-orders remaining objectives when intermediate rewards plateau, ensuring continued progress toward final goal.

next_experiments.title: Mentor Call Dependency Reduction
next_experiments.description: Introduce pre-call diagnostics that evaluate which policy branches are uncertain and resolve them before requesting mentor feedback.

next_experiments.title: Reconnaissance-to-Action Translation
next_experiments.description: Automate conversion of reconnaissance results into explicit tasks with measurable checkpoints to force action plan execution.
